lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gill region, forming approximately five discernible horizontal rows along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal carinae are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal surface of the ridge and shadowed low intensity on the ventral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin, situated at the upper-left dorsal margin, displays an irregular distribution of high-luminance spots across its visible surface, though partially obscured by surface glare.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple remoras is visible on the ventral side of the shark, extending from the gills toward the posterior of the pectoral fin.
